summary: #smallpoems Sea dust sinks and rises in doldrums of dying seas tufts and puffs carving and converting air's abundance into rarity of life. Will colonies bloom into kingdoms fed on Phosphates of Anthropogenic invasions? A choking stratification as life begets life.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Sea dust
sinks and
  rises
in doldrums
  of dying
seas
tufts and puffs
carving and converting
air's abundance
  into rarity of
life.
Will colonies
  bloom into kingdoms
  fed on Phosphates of
Anthropogenic
    invasions?
A choking
stratification
as life
begets life.
